description:
Keep questions findable: list, create, update (rename, describe, archive) and delete projects, and list the labels on your questions. A project groups questions; delete removes the project only, never its questions. File a question with questions (action file) or with project_id and labels when asking.

Pass action: one of list, create, update, delete, labels. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- list: Your projects: groups of questions with a name and a description, bookmarked first, each with how many questions are filed in it. Archived projects are left out unless include_archived is true. A key made for a team lists the team's projects. Use a project_id with ask (actions ask and set), questions (action file) or results (action list). Arguments: include_archived. Read-only; needs questions:read.
- create: Makes a project to group questions, with a name and an optional description. Costs nothing. File questions in it with project_id on ask (actions ask and set), or later with questions (action file). Calling it twice makes two projects. Arguments: name (required), description. Changes something; needs questions:write.
- update: Renames a project, changes its description, or archives it (archived: true) or brings it back (false). Archiving a project leaves its questions as they are. Costs nothing. Arguments: project_id (required), name, description, archived. Changes something; needs questions:write.
- delete: Deletes a project for good. Its questions are not deleted: they keep their answers, results, labels and bookmarks, and are no longer in any project. Nothing is charged or refunded. To keep the project but hide it, use action update with archived: true instead. Confirm with the person first. Arguments: project_id (required). Destructive; needs questions:write.
- labels: The labels on your questions, most used first, with how many questions carry each. Use one as label in results (action list), or reuse it in questions (action file) or ask. No other arguments. Read-only; needs questions:read.

action.description: What to do. One of: list, create, update, delete, labels. Each action takes its own arguments; see the tool description.

archived.description: true archives the project, false brings it back. Its questions stay as they are. (Used by: update.)

description.description: create: What the project is for, up to 500 characters. update: A new description; null or an empty string clears it.

include_archived.description: Also list archived projects. Default false. (Used by: list.)

name.description: create: The project's name, up to 80 characters. update: A new name.

project_id.description: The project_id from projects, actions list or create. (Used by: update, delete.)
